pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: main hip 46 by 43 ft, short E-W ridge near y 520, dark N face about 8/12; its NW quarter is covered by the rear_left block

pieces.name: front
pieces.notes: long S block, E-W ridge near y 570, hipped at the W end near x 420, E end dies into the main S face; its N face about 6.5/12 (371 sq ft)

pieces.name: rear_left
pieces.notes: NW block beside the driveway notch: dark N hip triangle with base from x 453 to 558 on the N eave and apex near (533,473), so a short N-S ridge near x 533 running S into the main; v1 rect was too narrow (ridge on its E edge, fit 40%)

exclude_notes: dark flat strip with a white fascia line along the S side, rear patio cover, not the main roof
lawn and shadow W of the front block, trace overshoots about 4 ft
driveway notch NW of the main, concrete not roof
notes: 1-story: main E-W hip, long E-W front hip on the SW, and a NW block with a N-S ridge (rect widened so the ridge is centred). Confidence medium-high on main and front, medium on rear_left.
